reason: The lock-screen widget and one-tap start are the only things that actually save me time, and $4.99 once with no subscription is less than a coffee. I'd take the full bundle rather than fuss over packs.
objection: I don't want to pay for cosmetics, hats and themes are fluff. I'm only paying for the widget and the lock-screen timer, so I'm a bit annoyed they're bundled with the rest.
would_change_my_mind: If the widget and lock-screen timer didn't work reliably, or if the Start Kit alone cost much more than $1.99.
